ceoData.title: CEO Greeting
ceoData.subtitle: Thank you for visiting Metrosoft Co., Ltd.
content: Based on the spirits of creativity, challenge, and trust, all members of Metrosoft Co., Ltd. have prioritized developing S/W solutions that reflect the latest IT trends and providing related services to grow together with our customers.

In the small & medium hospital market, our products including the Metro-HIS system, Metro-EMR, Metro-ERP, Metro-SMS, and Metro-CRM are highly recognized for their excellent quality. We are also accumulating technology through continuous R&D in healthcare content, Cloud computing, and medical AI.

Metrosoft Co., Ltd. is doing its best to improve services for End Users, and focuses on growing together with strategic partners striving to develop markets. In addition, we will continue to develop our own solutions for better services.
As a S/W solution development and service specialist company, Metrosoft Co., Ltd. aims to pursue sustainable development, inspire customers, and contribute to the nation and society.

voipData.intro: To reduce the burden of communication costs through landlines, our VoIP service utilizes existing or new internet lines to support affordable communication costs and dual-path communication between PSTN and PSDN for a more stable service.

contents.title: Safe even if internet or electricity is cut off.
If there is an issue with the internet or power, it automatically switches to KT landlines for safety.
Keep your existing phone numbers.
With the RID (number change) service, you can keep using your existing phone numbers and devices.
No dropouts or noise.
Prioritizing call quality, we adopt high-end uncompressed codec systems to guarantee the highest call quality.
Local rates apply even for out-of-town calls.
Enjoy calls at the lowest rates, regardless of internal or external destinations.
Same low rates even when calling special numbers.
Unlike other services where special numbers cannot be used or incur extra charges, you can call them at local rates.
Free calls between headquarters and branches.
Calls between headquarters and branches are free, and it is also free to your key clients if they also use our service.

intro.title: Metro-EMR
intro.subtitle: (Electronic Medical Record)
intro.content: A next-generation electronic medical record system developed to digitalize paper chart records / enhance medical information utilization by sharing charts across doctors and support departments / and improve clinical efficiency by eliminating manual storage and retrieval.
